t.E912.agn: In 2013 EFSA, noting that toxicokinetic, reproductive and developmental data were not available, that chronic toxicity studies had major shortcomings and that there had been no response to the 2012 call for data, concluded that the substance could not be evaluated as an additive. By Regulation 957/2014 the EU removed montan acid esters from the list of authorised additives.
t.E912.eff.0.t: EFSA could not evaluate it because toxicokinetic, reproductive and developmental data were lacking; the EU removed it from the authorised list in 2014
t.E912.eval: No longer authorised as a food additive in the EU: removed from the authorised list by Regulation (EU) 957/2014 (in 2013 EFSA could not evaluate it owing to insufficient data).
t.E912.found.0: Not authorised in the EU since 2014; previously authorised only for the surface treatment of fresh fruit
t.E912.prod: Produced by oxidising montan wax, extracted from lignite (brown coal) with solvents, with chromosulfuric acid and esterifying the resulting montan acids with diols and triols.
t.E912.regx.0: Removed from the list of authorised additives (Regulation 957/2014).
t.E912.regx.1: Could not be evaluated owing to insufficient data.
t.E912.summary: Esters of wax obtained from lignite. Used in coating citrus peel.
t.E912.what: Esters of acids obtained from lignite (montan) wax; previously used on the surface of fresh fruit.
